## Load packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rprojroot)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Seurat)
  library(patchwork)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(SeuratExtend)
})

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "downstream-analyses")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results", "tcell")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots", "tcell")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Analysis parameters
subtype_label <- "tcell"
```

## Load v2 tcell object
```{r load-data}
tcell_obj <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cart_tcell_subtypes_v2.rds"))

table(tcell_obj$tcell_subtype)
```

## Slingshot for Pseudotime Analysis
```{r prepare-slingshot-object}
traj_obj <- subset(
  tcell_obj,
  subset = !tcell_subtype %in% c(
    "Antigen-presenting myeloid cells",
    "NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes"
  )
)
```

```{r run-slingshot}
traj_obj[["CCA20"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = Embeddings(traj_obj, "integrated.cca")[, 1:20, drop = FALSE],
  key = "CCA20_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(traj_obj)
)

traj_obj <- RunSlingshot(
  traj_obj, 
  group.by = "tcell_subtype", 
  reducedDim = "CCA20",
  start.clus = "Naïve / central-memory T cells")
```

```{r}
sling <- traj_obj@misc$slingshot$CCA20$SlingPseudotime
head(sling)
```

```{r}
traj_obj@meta.data[,colnames(sling)] <- as.data.frame(sling)

DimPlot2(traj_obj, reduction = "umap", features = colnames(sling), cols = "C", theme = NoAxes())
```

```{r}
sling_df <- as.data.frame(sling) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    traj_obj@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      dplyr::select(cell, tcell_subtype, seurat_clusters, condition),
    by = "cell"
  )
```

```{r}
sling_summary <- sling_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("slingPseudotime"),
    names_to = "lineage",
    values_to = "pseudotime"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage, tcell_subtype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median_pseudotime = median(pseudotime),
    mean_pseudotime = mean(pseudotime),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(lineage, median_pseudotime)

sling_summary
```

```{r}
p_sling_summary <- ggplot(sling_summary, aes(x = median_pseudotime, y = reorder(tcell_subtype, median_pseudotime))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#2166AC") +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free_y") +
  xlab("Median Slingshot pseudotime") +
  ylab("T cell subtype") +
  labs(size = "Cells")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "tcell_slingshot_pseudotime_all_lineages_summary.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_sling_summary,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

## Slingshot lineage curves on UMAP
```{r slingshot-lineage-curves-on-umap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sling_res <- traj_obj@misc$slingshot$CCA20

# Pseudotime matrix from Slingshot
sling <- sling_res$SlingPseudotime
pseudotime_cols <- colnames(sling)

# UMAP coordinates + metadata + pseudotime
umap_df <- Embeddings(traj_obj, "umap") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")

colnames(umap_df)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

umap_df <- umap_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    traj_obj@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      dplyr::select(
        cell,
        tcell_subtype,
        seurat_clusters,
        condition,
        dplyr::all_of(pseudotime_cols)
      ),
    by = "cell"
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build a smooth UMAP curve for each lineage using pseudotime order
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_umap_curve_from_pseudotime <- function(umap_df, lineage_col, lineage_name, approx_points = 150) {
  
  lineage_cells <- umap_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lineage_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pseudotime = .data[[lineage_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pseudotime) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell, UMAP_1, UMAP_2, pseudotime)
  
  if (nrow(lineage_cells) < 4) {
    return(
      lineage_cells %>%
        dplyr::mutate(lineage = lineage_name)
    )
  }
  
  # Bin cells along pseudotime to reduce noise and approximate a smooth trajectory
  n_bins <- min(approx_points, nrow(lineage_cells))
  
  binned_curve <- lineage_cells %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pt_bin = ceiling(dplyr::row_number() / nrow(lineage_cells) * n_bins)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pt_bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      pseudotime = median(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE),
      UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1, na.rm = TRUE),
      UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pseudotime)
  
  # Smooth the binned trajectory using base R smooth.spline
  if (nrow(binned_curve) >= 5 && length(unique(binned_curve$pseudotime)) >= 5) {
    
    pt_grid <- seq(
      min(binned_curve$pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(binned_curve$pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = approx_points
    )
    
    smoothed_curve <- tryCatch({
      fit_x <- smooth.spline(
        x = binned_curve$pseudotime,
        y = binned_curve$UMAP_1,
        spar = 0.6
      )
      
      fit_y <- smooth.spline(
        x = binned_curve$pseudotime,
        y = binned_curve$UMAP_2,
        spar = 0.6
      )
      
      tibble::tibble(
        pseudotime = pt_grid,
        UMAP_1 = predict(fit_x, pt_grid)$y,
        UMAP_2 = predict(fit_y, pt_grid)$y,
        lineage = lineage_name
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      binned_curve %>%
        dplyr::mutate(lineage = lineage_name)
    })
    
    return(smoothed_curve)
  }
  
  binned_curve %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lineage = lineage_name)
}

# Make UMAP curves for all lineages
curve_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  paste0("Lineage ", seq_along(pseudotime_cols)),
  ~ make_umap_curve_from_pseudotime(
    umap_df = umap_df,
    lineage_col = .x,
    lineage_name = .y,
    approx_points = 150
  )
)

# Approximate lineage nodes as subtype centroids among cells assigned to each lineage
lineage_node_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  paste0("Lineage ", seq_along(pseudotime_cols)),
  function(lineage_col, lineage_name) {
    umap_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lineage_col]])) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(tcell_subtype) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n = dplyr::n(),
        UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1, na.rm = TRUE),
        UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n >= 10) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lineage = lineage_name)
  }
)

# Endpoint labels for overview plot
lineage_endpoint_df <- curve_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Overview plot: all 7 lineage curves on UMAP
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_slingshot_overview <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = tcell_subtype),
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, group = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lineage_node_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = lineage_endpoint_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, label = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(color = "T cell subtype") +
  ggtitle("Slingshot lineage curves on UMAP")

p_slingshot_overview

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_lineage_curves_overview_umap.pdf"),
  plot = p_slingshot_overview,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One plot per lineage, similar to attached examples
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_one_sling_lineage <- function(lineage_id) {
  
  lineage_col <- pseudotime_cols[lineage_id]
  lineage_name <- paste0("Lineage ", lineage_id)
  
  lineage_umap_df <- umap_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lineage_col]]))
  
  crv_df <- curve_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(lineage == lineage_name)
  
  node_df <- lineage_node_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(lineage == lineage_name)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = umap_df,
      aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
      color = "grey88",
      size = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = lineage_umap_df,
      aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = tcell_subtype),
      size = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_path(
      data = crv_df,
      aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = node_df,
      aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
      color = "black",
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    theme_Publication() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(color = "T cell subtype") +
    ggtitle(paste0("Slingshot ", lineage_name))
}

lineage_plots <- lapply(seq_along(pseudotime_cols), plot_one_sling_lineage)

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_lineage_curves_each_lineage_umap.pdf"),
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  onefile = TRUE,
  family = "sans"
)

for (p in lineage_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

# Show first lineage in notebook
lineage_plots[[1]]
```
